integrity: Explicit distance witnesses prove feasibility. A one-vertex complement is impossible. At equality, the two omitted vertices must be on opposite sides; same-side visibility forces the omitted B-index above the largest selected A-index and the omitted A-index below the smallest selected B-index, uniquely giving a_1 and b_n.
scientific_limitations: Canonical half graphs only; arbitrary chain graphs are not classified.
The uniqueness statement begins at n=3.
Finite verification through n=10 is corroborative only.
Generic distance-hereditary and exhaustive enumeration algorithms compute instances but do not state the closed uniqueness formula.
title: The unique maximum mutual-visibility set of a half graph
